content.short: Fly.trade swaps assets between chains without requiring a separate bridging step.
content.description: Fly.trade executes swaps on a single chain or across chains, pricing each one against multiple liquidity sources to find the best route. Users complete a swap in three steps without managing a separate bridge transaction. The protocol publishes its supported chains, liquidity sources and cumulative executed swap volume.
content.meta: Fly.trade performs cross-chain swaps in one step, without a separate bridging transaction.
